content: The Duke of Gododdin left his Infected soldiers behind, just like the other dukes?

speaker: Delphine
content: Or maybe...?

raw: [name="Siege"]Or maybe, he intentionally picked a bunch of soldiers who had unfortunately gotten Infected, and sent them over to us.
speaker: Siege
content: Or maybe, he intentionally picked a bunch of soldiers who had unfortunately gotten Infected, and sent them over to us.

speaker: Delphine
content: I suspect he has ulterior motives.

raw: [name="Delphine"]The performance of those Infected troops indicates that they're different from those we've seen before. I wouldn't call them stragglers.
speaker: Delphine
content: The performance of those Infected troops indicates that they're different from those we've seen before. I wouldn't call them stragglers.

raw: [name="Delphine"]If Gododdin's intention is to keep an eye on us, then we should probably try to lose these people, or at least separate them tactically...
speaker: Delphine
content: If Gododdin's intention is to keep an eye on us, then we should probably try to lose these people, or at least separate them tactically...

speaker: Siege
content: No.

raw: [name="Siege"]You know the dukes better than I, Delphine. There's a very good chance that you're right.
speaker: Siege
content: You know the dukes better than I, Delphine. There's a very good chance that you're right.

raw: [name="Siege"]But right now, there's nothing we need more than unity.
speaker: Siege
content: But right now, there's nothing we need more than unity.

raw: [name="Siege"]If even the Exemplars chose which parts of Victoria they united...
speaker: Siege
content: If even the Exemplars chose which parts of Victoria they united...

raw: [name="Siege"]What would happen to the future that we dream of?
speaker: Siege
content: What would happen to the future that we dream of?

raw: [name="Delphine"]Gododdin very likely knew that we couldn't reject those men. That's why he let us leave so easily.
speaker: Delphine
content: Gododdin very likely knew that we couldn't reject those men. That's why he let us leave so easily.

speaker: Siege
content: Then we need to be ready.

raw: [name="Siege"]This is not the first challenge we've had to overcome, nor will it be the last.
speaker: Siege
content: This is not the first challenge we've had to overcome, nor will it be the last.

speaker: Siege
content: Sarkaz. Amnannam. Caster. The dukes.

raw: [name="Siege"]It's not just one storm that the Exemplars will have to weather.
speaker: Siege
content: It's not just one storm that the Exemplars will have to weather.

speaker: Delphine
content: I'll let Lieutenant Shearer know.

raw: [name="Delphine"]To be honest, everyone's happy to get some new blood.
speaker: Delphine
content: To be honest, everyone's happy to get some new blood.

speaker: Siege
content: Plus, they're all Infected.

raw: [name="Siege"]If it's really true that Gododdin has not abandoned them... that, in itself, is worth celebrating.
speaker: Siege
content: If it's really true that Gododdin has not abandoned them... that, in itself, is worth celebrating.

raw: [name="Siege"]Perhaps, the unity that once seemed impossible is actually within reach.
speaker: Siege
content: Perhaps, the unity that once seemed impossible is actually within reach.

raw: [name="Pained Refugee"]It's a miracle to run into people like you.
speaker: Pained Refugee
content: It's a miracle to run into people like you.

speaker: Fang
content: We're not the miracle, ma'am.

raw: [name="Fang"]You are, all of you, for being strong until the very end.
speaker: Fang
content: You are, all of you, for being strong until the very end.

speaker: Pained Refugee
content: Thank you so much, regardless.

raw: [name="Pained Refugee"]I can still move. Let me help you with the others.
speaker: Pained Refugee
content: I can still move. Let me help you with the others.

raw: [name="Pained Refugee"]This way, you can get some rest... you're not much older than my own child, now that I get a better look at you.
speaker: Pained Refugee
content: This way, you can get some rest... you're not much older than my own child, now that I get a better look at you.

raw: [name="Fang"]We have about ten minutes of rest before we head to the next location.
speaker: Fang
content: We have about ten minutes of rest before we head to the next location.

speaker: Fang
content: ...Closure?

speaker: Closure
content: A little more time...

raw: [name="Fang"]There's not much room for improvement on that Arts Unit you're holding.
speaker: Fang
content: There's not much room for improvement on that Arts Unit you're holding.

raw: [name="Fang"]Even Raidian and Mechanist could hardly do better.
speaker: Fang
content: Even Raidian and Mechanist could hardly do better.

raw: [name="Closure"]Conditions will only get worse from here. The better I do, the safer you guys will be.
speaker: Closure
content: Conditions will only get worse from here. The better I do, the safer you guys will be.

speaker: Fang
content: Thanks.

raw: [name="Fang"]Rescue work around Gibsonham is complete. Next, we'll be going to... where your squad's signal was lost.
speaker: Fang
content: Rescue work around Gibsonham is complete. Next, we'll be going to... where your squad's signal was lost.

speaker: Closure
content: I see.

speaker: Fang
content: We'll find them, alive or... otherwise.

raw: [name="Fang"]Even if they're buried in the sand, or Originium... there will be traces.
speaker: Fang
content: Even if they're buried in the sand, or Originium... there will be traces.

raw: [name="Fang"]We'll find them and bring them home.
speaker: Fang
content: We'll find them and bring them home.

raw: [name="Closure"]I know how I feel, but Fang... I want to hear your thoughts, too.
speaker: Closure
content: I know how I feel, but Fang... I want to hear your thoughts, too.

raw: [name="Closure"]Is it regrettable for a Rhodes Island operator to die in a war between the Sarkaz and the Victorians, when they have nothing to do with either side of the war?
speaker: Closure
content: Is it regrettable for a Rhodes Island operator to die in a war between the Sarkaz and the Victorians, when they have nothing to do with either side of the war?

speaker: Fang
content: Any sacrifice is regrettable.

raw: [name="Fang"]After Ace died, Beagle cried for many nights with his shield in her arms.
speaker: Fang
content: After Ace died, Beagle cried for many nights with his shield in her arms.

speaker: Fang
content: Why him? Why there? Why then?

raw: [name="Closure"]I get that feeling too. Every single time.
speaker: Closure
content: I get that feeling too. Every single time.

raw: [name="Closure"]But what I really want to know is... how did the people who sacrificed feel?
speaker: Closure
content: But what I really want to know is... how did the people who sacrificed feel?

raw: [name="Fang"]Hm... I'm sure they have their own regrets.
speaker: Fang
content: Hm... I'm sure they have their own regrets.

raw: [name="Fang"]We're none of us saints. That's why we fear death. That's why you feel pain over your decision.
speaker: Fang
content: We're none of us saints. That's why we fear death. That's why you feel pain over your decision.

raw: [name="Fang"]But I have no regrets about participating in this operation.
speaker: Fang
content: But I have no regrets about participating in this operation.

raw: [name="Fang"]If not for Lava, Hibiscus, or our other Sarkaz friends, then at least for the people here, even though I don't know any of them.
speaker: Fang
content: If not for Lava, Hibiscus, or our other Sarkaz friends, then at least for the people here, even though I don't know any of them.

raw: [name="Fang"]It was a Catastrophe that brought me from Columbia to Rhodes Island.
speaker: Fang
content: It was a Catastrophe that brought me from Columbia to Rhodes Island.

raw: [name="Fang"]That Catastrophe taught me one thing: that suffering does not discriminate.
speaker: Fang
content: That Catastrophe taught me one thing: that suffering does not discriminate.

raw: [name="Fang"]I came here today because I know that you will come when my home needs help, when the people I care about need help.
speaker: Fang
content: I came here today because I know that you will come when my home needs help, when the people I care about need help.

speaker: Closure
content: You're right.

speaker: Closure
content: We'll be there.
